description: Turn whichpart-api rate limiting from observe to enforce (RATE_LIMIT_MODE=enforce). Observe data since 7.5: no request over any limit; the busiest 10 minutes in the last 10 days (434 turns, a batch run on 2026-10-04) is under every enforced limit. Enforced: sign-in 5 per email and 60 overall per 15 minutes; customer turns 40 per conversation, 600 per network source and 1200 overall per 10 minutes. Per-IP counts stay advisory (X-Forwarded-For is viewer-controlled). Environment only; rollback is the same change with observe.
grantNotes: Environment only: UpdateFunctionConfiguration on whichpart-api, and PassRole on its own role (CloudFormation passes the role with the configuration).
